framework.reasoning: D3LM is released on the HuggingFace Hub (Hengchang-Liu/D3LM-from-nt = D3LM, Hengchang-Liu/D3LM-scratch = D3LM-R), both 50M, built on the NT-v2 (ESM encoder + RoPE + SwiGLU) architecture. It loads via AutoModelForMaskedLM(trust_remote_code=True) and ships a custom diffusion_generate() + MDMGenerationConfig, so generation and understanding both run off the official weights (like Caduceus/DNAGPT). The masked-diffusion ALGORITHM (variable-ratio forward masking, 1/t-weighted CE on masked tokens, iterative reverse unmasking with temperature/random order) is the paper's contribution and is re-implemented from scratch in plain PyTorch so it is CPU-unit-testable without weights. Generation quality is checked with cheap REAL metrics (GC ratio / Chargaff parity, Diversity=avg pairwise Levenshtein, Novelty) that need no extra model; SFID (which needs the pretrained Sei genomic CNN) is computed only if Sei loads. No custom CUDA kernels, so cuda_required=false; GPU only speeds up generation.

module_hierarchy.description: From-scratch reference for the masked-diffusion objective + sampler: forward masking (each token -> [M] w.p. t), the 1/t-weighted cross-entropy loss (Eq 2), and the iterative reverse unmasking loop (Eq 4) with temperature scaling and pluggable unmasking order (random/confidence). CPU-testable; the real forward pass uses the official ESM/NT-v2 backbone.

module_hierarchy.description: Non-overlapping 6-mer DNA tokenizer (vocab ~4105); wraps the official tokenizer when the weights are present, else a faithful built-in 6-mer vocab.

EPD-GenDNA loader (DiscDiff dataset, mammalian subset, 2048/256 bp). Downloads via the released dataset when available; else a synthetic promoter-like generator (clearly labeled) so the pipeline/tests run.

Generation metrics: GC ratio (Chargaff parity, #G/#C), Diversity (avg pairwise Levenshtein), Novelty (min edit distance to train set), and SFID (Sei-based Frechet distance) if the Sei model is available.
Motif frequency distributions (TATA-box, Initiator, GC-box, CCAAT-box) along the sequence + Pearson correlation to natural DNA (CorTATA etc.), as used by DiscDiff/D3LM figures.
YAML config loader + seeding + model registry (D3LM / D3LM-R HF ids, generation defaults T=50 tau=1.1).

tensor_flows.name: Unconditional generation (masked diffusion)
steps: start from an all-[M] sequence of length L
for T steps: predict p(x0|xt) at all masked positions (bidirectional ESM/NT-v2 forward)
select a subset U_t to unmask (random order), sample with temperature tau=1.1
keep unmasked tokens, re-mask the rest, until t reaches 0

tensor_flows.name: Masked-diffusion training step (reference)
steps: sample t ~ U[0,1]; mask each token independently w.p. t -> xt
CE on masked positions only, weighted by 1/t (Eq 2)

entrypoints.purpose: Generate DNA sequences with D3LM (unconditional, masked diffusion)
Evaluate generated sequences (GC ratio, diversity, novelty, SFID)
Download D3LM weights (HF) and/or EPD-GenDNA data

risk_assessment.description: SFID (the paper's headline metric) needs the pretrained Sei genomic CNN (20k chromatin profiles); it may be large/awkward to load in Colab, so exact SFID reproduction is not guaranteed.
risk_assessment.mitigation: Compute cheap REAL metrics that need no extra model first (GC ratio ~1.0 Chargaff parity, Diversity, Novelty, motif Pearson corr); attempt SFID only if Sei loads. GC ratio alone strongly discriminates good vs collapsed generation (paper: D3LM-R 1.07 vs Evo 0.86, P2-collapse 12.7).

risk_assessment.description: D3LM ships custom diffusion_generate() remote code; very new transformers can break older custom modeling code (as seen with Caduceus/DNAGPT).
risk_assessment.mitigation: Pin transformers >=4.38,<4.46; provide a from-scratch reverse-unmasking loop as a fallback that drives the model's plain masked-LM forward directly.

risk_assessment.description: EPD-GenDNA full dataset is large; mammalian subset extraction is nontrivial.
risk_assessment.mitigation: download.py fetches the released dataset; a clearly-labeled synthetic fallback keeps the pipeline + tests runnable without it.

risk_assessment.description: Exact vocab (4105 vs 4107) differs between paper and HF config.
risk_assessment.mitigation: read vocab from the released tokenizer at load; never hardcode.
